title: Ethiopian Chicken Doro Wot
description: A flavorful and spicy Ethiopian chicken stew made with tender chicken, onions, garlic, ginger, and berbere spice.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the berbere spice, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add 1 cup of water to the pan and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot over rice or with injera bread.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
Serve with additional berbere spice on the side, if desired.
